primarySources.fact: Child pointer-down notifications reach ancestor windows; children with WS_EX_NOPARENTNOTIFY may suppress them. Therefore registration alone does not prove this receiver emits a usable event; actual validation is required.

proposal.phase: Implement mouse receipt first, because it has exact actual failure evidence. Preserve existing F handling. Prepare a separately enabled Escape-only receipt path only after root observes its actual native key_released failure and approves that extension; do not silently implement it from the mouse finding.
proposal.localOwnership: New SOOP VOD-owned native input-intent helper, with no import of YouTube-owned state and no edits to streaming/browser_pane_focus.rs. Subclass only this exact controller's ParentWindow child after checking its direct parent is the main HWND; never root, unrelated app, login popup or arbitrary descendant windows. Use a distinct subclass callback/ID. No global input hook, low-level key capture or background polling.
proposal.nativePress: Observe only native WM_LBUTTONDOWN or WM_PARENTNOTIFY carrying WM_LBUTTONDOWN. At WndProc first entry, before COM, DefSubclassProc or any wait, snapshot GetAsyncKeyState native down plus foreground/enabled/visible owned-child/hit conditions, source binding and event time. Use nonblocking session snapshot attempts; inability to obtain a coherent binding fails closed. A later keyup does not erase that already-proven press. Preserve normal DefSubclassProc delivery and existing pointer-focus repair chain; afterward recheck same binding, foreground/visibility/hit and exact pane focus before storing the receipt using the original observation time. Do not call MoveFocus, SetFocus, SetCapture, Handled, JS eval, fullscreen or disk/network operations. Keep an Rc/Weak lifetime guard and no session mutex across DefSubclassProc or COM; WM_NCDESTROY removes this subclass and clears its receipt.
proposal.playerOnly: SOOP VOD player and chat share the same native pane, so HWND hit alone is insufficient. Sample GetCursorPos, convert using ScreenToClient(main) and current GetDpiForWindow(main)/96, and require the private point inside the source-owned viewport.player rectangle, outside its chat rectangle and any clipped/occluded area; retain exact WindowFromPoint hit too. Repeat after forwarding and at consumption. Reject zero/unsupported DPI, nonfinite bounds, changed viewport geometry/DPI and failed conversion. Coordinates stay private and are never logged. A narrow windows feature Win32_UI_HiDpi may be required solely for GetDpiForWindow; root must approve that feature line before Cargo.toml editing. No existing DPI awareness or layout setting changes.
proposal.binding: At most one pending receipt per owned controller, maximum500ms from observation. Bind to current document epoch, current presenter alias, current optional fullscreen Grant and intended transition (enter if no current grant, exit if exactly that grant). In-memory binding also belongs to the immutable native root/pane/controller instance. Same press must not authorize both directions, a replacement alias, a new document, another grant or another receiver. Coalesce duplicate native notifications for one physical press so forwarding cannot replenish a consumed receipt; a release may permit a later new press but does not erase the pending asynchronous delivery receipt.
proposal.consumption: For a canonical/current mouse fullscreen message only, validate its enabled boolean equals the bound intended transition and its exact source/label/UUID/epoch checks still pass. Consume the receipt once whether the attempt succeeds or fails, even if the button remains held. No missing/expired/foreign/consumed receipt may fall back to the currently-held bit. Recheck current presenter, epoch, optional grant, visible viewport, foreground/enabled native pane, exact focus and cursor hit. Only the physical still-down requirement may be satisfied by the previously proven native press; every other guard remains. No grace period based solely on a JavaScript message or isTrusted claim.
proposal.transition: Exit releases the captured exact Grant, not whatever grant is current later. Entry is tied to the captured presenter/epoch/no-grant state; do not read a newer presenter when invoking acquire. Recheck that binding at the coordinator's pre-dispatch validity point and ensure a post-acquire validation can recognize only this newly accepted grant, not a different intervening grant. Keep source-local callbacks and existing global presentation serialization. Do not add a generic privileged fullscreen API.
proposal.invalidation: LostFocus, pane destruction, closure, changed epoch/presenter/grant, hidden viewport or changed ownership invalidate the receipt. Native helpers may retain a bounded stale value until consumed, but it cannot become valid again after leaving and returning; include an invalidation generation or clear on those actual lifecycle transitions. No inactive or recording-only pane can mint or consume an intent. Installation failure fails closed for this receipt path with a fixed diagnostic, without destroying the recording/account/session.
proposal.diagnostics: Keep the existing32attempt/64row budget and fixed stage/action/gate fields. A successful native-receipt use may add only existing receipt_used boolean; no event timing/coordinates/HWND/nonce/capability/alias/title/URL/input text or arbitrary error string. Distinguish accepted receipt use from a plain denial, but do not add an unbounded hook-event log.
proposal.sharedContext: Prefer a SOOP VOD-private read-only pointer context helper with the same foreground/visibility/enabled/focus/hit checks. No shared native input gate edit is needed. Do not misuse the Escape-named context for mouse and do not expose a generic skip-input-validation parameter. All preexisting provider calls retain their exact current behavior.
proposal.escapeConditional: If separately authorized after actual evidence: copy the strict SOOP-local Escape receipt protocol using this controller's AcceleratorKeyPressed, first nonrepeated unmodified Escape only, current exact presenter/epoch/Grant and500ms/one-use/LostFocus invalidation. The page's existing chat/editable/menu/IME exclusions remain authoritative before requesting exit. Both held and released Escape need the exact receipt; no old-press/new-grant fallback. This is not part of mouse implementation approval unless root explicitly adds it.
proposal.unsupportedF: Leave F unchanged. No reliable plain-character F event is established by the documented accelerator API; root actual no-envelope evidence is a separate document-target issue. Do not subclass Chromium's keyboard child, add a general keyboard hook, broaden modifiers, poll keys or relax the existing native check to claim F repaired.
